CedarShore and SugarMaple are newly constructed apartments in our families Office Building on Route 102 at the entrance to Smuggler's Den. Our family businesses offices are upstairs. We designed these apartments to feel open and cheerful (think of the show Fixer Upper) with distressed white wood flooring, shiplap style accent walls and black fixtures. These rentals have adjoining doors and adjoining barn doors on the screen porches.
